definitions.Fit_S: one scalar per (q,c), fixed unnormalized centered/scaled readout B
definitions.Fit_F: rank-one SVD of raw (q,c) by (w,t) table; no pre-centering or intercept
definitions.undefined: null when the denominator is zero

definitions.zero_denominator: null; no clipping of negative explained fractions
definitions.refitted: one new shared 4x10 C fitted globally by raw rank-one SVD; lambda varies with q,c
definitions.fixed_C0: hold the initial globally fitted C0 fixed; refit only each q,c scalar lambda
definitions.per_block: score each block using the globally shared C, never an independently fitted per-block C
